pdp - rematch wireless gaming controller.description: Scare up some fun and light up the competition with the Boo-Hoo Rematch Wireless Controller for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and Nintendo Switch - OLED Model. This controller also works with Nintendo Switch 2 - C Button not available. When it comes to performance, the Rematch Wireless Controller shines. The controller’s built-in rechargeable battery delivers up to 40 hours of play on a single charge. Boo-Hoo also comes equipped with advanced features such as motion controls, adding an extra layer of immersion to your gameplay. These built-in motion controls let you steer, swing, and aim with natural movements, adding extra excitement to games like Super Mario Odyssey or the new Mario Kart World and Donkey Kong Bananza. With up to a 30-foot wireless range, you can comfortably play from anywhere in the room while staying fully engaged in your game. Additionally, two mappable back buttons can be customized to suit your gaming preferences. This allows for faster, more efficient in-game actions, giving you a competitive edge and a personalized gaming experience. Beyond top-tier performance, the gamepad stands out with its captivating glow-in-the-dark design. After exposure to light, the controller emits a soft, luminous glow that adds a unique, fun twist to your gaming setup. This special feature not only looks cool but also enhances your gaming ambiance, giving your setup a fresh and stylish look when you're in a darkened room. With bold style, responsive features, and a glow-in-the-dark design, the officially licensed Rematch Wireless Controller for Nintendo is ready for your next adventure.
